passages.provision_quote: In adopting rules and regulations to achieve the maximum technologically feasible and cost-effective greenhouse gas emissions reductions authorized by this division, the state board shall ensure that statewide greenhouse gas emissions are reduced to at least 40 percent below the statewide greenhouse gas emissions limit no later than December 31, 2030.
passages.note: SB 32's operative section sets a GHG emissions limit but names no energy source, so it matches only the pro-action direction, not rung 1's clean-energy clause (H17).
Assembly Floor vote page shows Gipson's Aye on SB 32; the vote carries the same shape as the bill it enacts.

rows.reasoning: SB 32 (2015-2016), which Gipson voted Aye on in the Assembly, sets a GHG emissions limit (reduced to at least 40 percent below the statewide limit by December 31, 2030) but names no energy source as the means, so per V4.2 'the rung's object is a clause' (H17) it establishes only the pro-action direction, not rung 1's 'shift to clean energy' clause; BLANK direction-only.
